identity: A flattened page-spread from the Emirati children's magazine Majid (the recurring header and footer نادي ماجد للهوايات bracket it). Not continuous prose but layout debris set in reading order: a photo caption of Sheikh Khalifa bin Zayed with the Al Ain squad; banner headlines (مبروك ل العين / كأس الإمارات لكرة القدم); a second verbless caption naming three sheikhs; a short news write-up of Al Ain winning the 1998-99 UAE President's Cup; then a run of hobby-column factoids each under its own heading (رفع أثقال، أبطال فوق العادة with هوايتي ركوب الموج، دراجات نارية، دراجات هوائية، ألعاب شعبية with الهوسة); a stray surfing-competition paragraph bled in from another column out of topical order; and a closing headline-plus-caption and section footer. Register: plain expository MSA for young readers, heavily wa- and fa- chained, interleaved with verbless headline and caption fragments.
law: Default: one paragraph equals one sentence. This writer uses the paragraph break itself as his full stop, and the دراجات هوائية section proves it, where tokens 511, 523 and 533 each open a fresh و-clause and each gets its own <NL>. Inside a paragraph a break needs positive evidence. (1) Asyndeton is decisive: two complete predications juxtaposed with no connective at all is always a full stop. (2) و and ف are NEUTRAL, neither creating nor blocking a break, because Arabic journalism opens sentences with و freely; a wa-clause breaks only when it also carries a real discourse move AND the paragraph is too long to be one sentence. This page's sentences run about 8 to 45 tokens, so a 103-token paragraph must be split, while a 30-token single-topic paragraph must not. (3) Never break at a subordinator: حيث، حتى، التي/الذي، أن، بمعنى أن، and purpose-ل (ليأتي، ليختتم، ليتحقق، ليتوج). (4) Distinguish an asyndetic RELATIVE clause (indefinite antecedent and/or resumptive pronoun) from an asyndetic INDEPENDENT clause (its own overt subject); only the latter is a boundary. (5) A headline or label swallowed into the body paragraph, and a closing exclamatory formula, are each their own sentence. (6) A verbless caption NP chained with و is one unit however long, since there is no predication to break.
reasoning: SITE 128 النهائية: the paragraph reads استحق ... لأول مرة بعد 30 عاما من الانتظار وبعد 6 مرات وصول للمباراة النهائية | حقق لاعبو الفريق العيناوي هذا الإنجاز. The two بعد phrases are a bound parallel pair naming one idea (the drought), so the split cannot fall at 122 and separate them; it falls after النهائية, where حقق is verb-initial with a fresh overt subject لاعبو الفريق and carries NO connective. Anaphoric هذا الإنجاز confirms a preceding closed sentence. Marked med only because 122 is the rival placement. SITE 310 الموج: هوايتي ركوب الموج is a sub-heading run into its own body; هذه الهواية at 311 points back at it as antecedent, so two predications sit asyndetically adjacent. SITE 320 الموج: نشأت is feminine and agrees with الهواية, not with masculine الموج, so it cannot be a relative clause on the preceding noun, and it has no و or ف; independent clause, full stop. The following وتمارس shares that subject and stays inside. RELATIVE-CLAUSE TRAP, the control on the above: قدمت at 190 modifies indefinite مباراة, حققتها at 498 carries a resumptive -ها back to 10 مرات, أقيمت at 238 follows التي, and تقسم at 618 is circumstantial on مساحة الملعب with no overt subject. None of these is a boundary, and that test is exactly what licenses حقق، نشأت، يفصل. SITE 597 لاعبين: يفصل has its own postposed subject خط فاصل مرسوم على الأرض in VOS order, so it is not a modifier of لاعبين; asyndetic independent clause. THE 103-TOKEN الهوسة PARAGRAPH (635-737): at this page's sentence rate it must hold four or five sentences, so و cannot be treated as blocking here. I take 648 الهول (setup by the referee's announcement gives way to the action, وهنا being a sentence-initial discourse marker), 683 اللعبة (أما is the ONLY clause-initial position in the whole 103 tokens that carries no و and no ف, and my law makes asyndeton decisive), 691 خاسرا (individual duel outcome gives way to the game's duration rule with fresh subject هذه اللعبة), and 709 النهاية (new rule entirely, substitution rights). I deliberately REJECT 668 before فإذا: that ف marks tight consequence inside the single description of the struggle (he tries to drag, his teammates help, so if he manages), and splitting there would also strand the فإذا / أما إذا conditional pair across two sentences when the أما arm is better read as opening the next one. Yielding units of 14, 35, 8, 18 and 28 tokens, all within range. SITE 797 الإمارات: عيناوي بطلا لكأس الإمارات is a headline in accusative-حال style, and فريق نادي العين بطل كأس صاحب السمو is a complete nominal caption; asyndetic juxtaposition, same pattern as 310. SITE 852 بطلا: مبروك للعين هذا الفوز الرائع is an exclamatory congratulation formula appended with no connective after ليتوج نادي العين بطلا. HELD WHOLE, the close calls I declined. 386 الشاطئ before ومن ثم وفور مشاهدة الأمواج: 39 tokens, one procedural topic, and the stacked و on ومن and وفور reads as comma-parenthesis rather than a new sentence. 288 وستتراوح: 30 tokens, both future verbs on the single topic of Sydney 2000, و-coordinated. 351 ويكون and 621 وعلى خط الوسط and 626 وتحتاج: short descriptive paragraphs on one topic each (the board, the field). 762-779 in the bled-in surfing paragraph: 37 tokens of و-chained passives all about surfing contests, and وهي at 779 continues عدد من الأمواج. 834 وتفرح: inside the long closing caption, which runs جاء ... حتى ... التي ... ليتحقق ... وتفرح ... ليتوج as one chain with no asyndeton. The 47-token sheikh caption at 52-98 is verbless throughout, a single و-list of who appears in the photo, so there is no predication to break and it stays one unit despite its length; likewise the 42-token opening caption, whose subject is the long titled NP and whose predicate is يتوسط, with حيث subordinating the rest.
